LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Fractures_EnableToo: Damage can fracture bones, especially from blunt impacts.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Fractures_DamageThr: Minimum damage required for an impact to cause a fracture.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Fractures_FractureC: Chance of bone fractures on damage: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Chance to fracture the hit part once the damage requirements are met.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Fractures_EnableLac: Fractures can cause additional cuts from bone fragments.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Fractures_Laceratio: Chance for a fracture to splinter and threaten nearby parts with bone fragments.
Chance for each nearby part to receive cuts from a splintering fracture.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Fractures_ApplySpli: Enable splinting work giver for doctors (default: {DEFAULT})
Doctors automatically splint fractures when the patient is in bed and a splint is accessible. Disable to require manual orders.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Respiratory_EnableC: Severe bleeding injuries to the respiratory system can obstruct breathing with blood. Clear the airway with CPR or suction.
Play a sound when a pawn starts choking on blood.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Respiratory_Choking: Minimum respiratory-injury bleed rate that can cause choking on blood.
Chance of choking on blood after severe damage: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Chance to choke on blood from qualifying respiratory injuries.
Minimum suction device success rate for unskilled users: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Minimum suction success chance. Medical skill improves success up to 100% at skill 8.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Respiratory_EnableI: Fire, smoke and hot gases can injure the respiratory system.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Respiratory_EnableL: Explosions and penetrating injuries can collapse lungs. Below 45% severity, decent tending permits recovery; at 45% or above, surgery is required. Collapse does not worsen on its own.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Respiratory_LungCol: Chance of lung collapse on thermobaric damage: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Explosion-induced lung-collapse chance, scaled by damage. Set to zero to disable.
Chance of lung collapse on perforating damage: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Penetrating-injury lung-collapse chance, scaled by damage. Set to zero to disable.
Maximum initial lung collapse severity factor: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Maximum added collapse severity is this value squared; lower severities are more common. At 0.5, each application adds at most 25% severity. Repeated injuries stack.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Spalling_EnableTool: Projectiles stopped by armor can cause fragment injuries to exposed parts.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Spalling_DamageThre: Base spalling chance from armor condition: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Spalling_ChanceTool: Chance for each exposed part to receive fragment injuries after spalling occurs. Impact angle and armor condition also affect the result.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HypovolemicShock_En: Blood loss above 45% can cause shock, organ damage and acidosis. Restore blood volume; good tending slows deterioration. Disabling lets existing shock subside but leaves its complications.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HypovolemicShock_Hy: Chance of hypovolemic shock to cause hypoxia (checked every 250 and 500 ticks): {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Chance of random hypoxic organ injury from shock. With delayed vital failure enabled, cerebral hypoxia accumulates separately; setting this chance to zero does not stop it.
Hypoxia chance multiplier at 100% shock tend quality: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Organ-injury risk multiplier at 100% shock tend quality. Lower-quality tends offer less protection; 0% quality offers none. Tending also slows shock and helps recovery, but does not replace blood.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HypovolemicShock_En: Enable hypovolemic shock to cause cardiac arrest (default: {DEFAULT})
Severe blood loss can cause cardiac arrest. CPR may restart the heart; restore blood volume as well.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HypovolemicShock_Ca: Chance of cardiac arrest on high blood loss: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Chance of cardiac arrest during severe blood loss, checked every 250 ticks.
Minimum defibrillator success rate for unskilled user: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Minimum defibrillator success chance. Medical skill improves success up to 100% at skill 10, before treatment modifiers.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HypovolemicShock_De: Chance of a defibrillator breaking after use: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Chance for a defibrillator to break after each use.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_LethalTriad_EnableT: Enables interacting hypothermia, acidosis and coagulopathy, which can worsen bleeding and become fatal.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_LethalTriad_Prevent: Prevent direct death by blood loss (default: {DEFAULT})

Prevents direct death at full blood loss for supported humanlikes, fleshy alien races and bleeding Anomaly entities. Animals retain normal blood-loss death. Shock and other complications can still kill; forced blood harvesting remains lethal.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_LethalTriad_Hypoxia: Scales acidosis from hypoxic injury and sustained shock. Zero stops new production from both sources; existing acidosis clears gradually.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_LethalTriad_Coagulo: Saline IV infusion safety threshold of independent coagulopathy: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})

Refuse automatic saline when coagulopathy from causes other than dilution exceeds this threshold. Zero permits none; one ignores those other causes. Dilution safety checks still apply. Forced single infusions bypass safety checks.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_NeuralDamage_Enable: Enables lasting neurological disabilities from hypoxia, toxins and head trauma. Delayed vital failure separately controls acute cerebral hypoxia and its fatal threshold.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_NeuralDamage_Treatm: Reduction factor for neurological damage chance when patient is tended: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Tending reduces the risk of further neurological damage by this factor. Treat the underlying cause for lasting stabilization.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_NeuralDamage_Enable: Allow neurological damage to personality shifts (default: {DEFAULT})
Neurological damage can redistribute skills and passions. Greater damage causes larger changes.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Concussion_EnableTo: Head injuries can cause temporary concussion and reduced consciousness.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Concussion_DamageTh: Raw head trauma threshold for guaranteed concussion: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Trauma needed for a full concussion application. Weaker hits add proportionally less severity. Damage type, location and part health affect trauma.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Concussion_Concussi: Chance of concussion after severe head injuries: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Concussion severity added by a hit meeting the trauma threshold. One adds a full concussion; weaker hits add proportionally less.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HemorrhagicStroke_E: Allows head trauma, hydrostatic shock, coagulopathy and adrenaline overdose to cause or worsen strokes. Disabling does not remove existing strokes or stop their progression; treatment remains available.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HemorrhagicStroke_D: Raw head trauma threshold for guaranteed hemorrhagic stroke: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Trauma needed for a full stroke application. Weaker hits add proportionally less severity. Damage type, location and part health affect trauma.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HemorrhagicStroke_S: Chance of hemorrhagic stroke after severe head injuries: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Stroke severity added by a hit meeting the trauma threshold. One adds a full stroke; weaker hits add proportionally less.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_EmpDamage_EnableToo: EMP damage can temporarily disable bionic parts.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_EmpDamage_ChanceLab: Chance of EMP damage to bionics: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_EmpDamage_ChanceToo: Chance for each bionic part to shut down after an EMP hit.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Adrenaline_EnableTo: Injuries can trigger adrenaline, boosting movement and reducing pain. Disabling also stops epinephrine injections during drafted first aid.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Adrenaline_DamageTh: Damage threshold for certain adrenaline rush: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Damage that guarantees an adrenaline rush. Below this threshold, the configured chance applies.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Adrenaline_ChanceLa: Chance of adrenaline rush on damage: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Adrenaline_ChanceTo: Chance of an adrenaline rush per damage event below the guaranteed threshold. Damage controls its intensity.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HydrostaticShock_En: High-energy projectile impacts can cause hemorrhagic strokes.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HydrostaticShock_Ch: Chance of hydrostatic shock on damage: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Stroke chance per high-energy projectile impact.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Tourniquets_EnableT: Prolonged tourniquet use can cause gangrene and limb loss. Remove tourniquets once proper treatment is available.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Tourniquets_Gangren: Mean time until gangrene from tourniquet: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Average time between gangrene events in downstream parts, such as fingers or toes, at maximum tourniquet severity.
Chance of dry gangrene from tourniquet: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})

Chance that new gangrene starts dry rather than infected. One means always dry; 0.8 means 80% dry and 20% wet. Both destroy tissue; wet gangrene threatens fatal sepsis, and dry gangrene can become wet.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Tourniquets_WetGang: Mean time to infection from dry gangrene: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Average time before dry gangrene becomes infected wet gangrene. Wet gangrene requires urgent amputation.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Tourniquets_ShowGiz: Show a command for selected pawns to apply or remove their own tourniquets.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Tourniquets_MinBlee: Minimum bleed rate for auto tourniquet: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Minimum limb bleed rate for automatic tourniquet application during first aid. Below it, doctors tend instead. Also controls limb colors in the tourniquet menu.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HearingDamage_Enabl: Gunfire and explosions can damage hearing. Indoor gunfire is more dangerous; ear-covering apparel reduces risk.
Also exposes bystanders near shooters to hearing damage. Requires basic hearing damage. Can slow large battles, especially with Combat Extended; disabled by default.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HearingDamage_Gunsh: Scaling factor for hearing damage caused by gunshots: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Scales temporary hearing damage from gunfire. Weapon loudness and distance affect exposure.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HearingDamage_Explo: Scaling factor for hearing damage caused by explosions: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Scales temporary hearing damage from explosions according to exposure.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_HearingDamage_Perma: Severe hearing damage can become permanent (default: {DEFAULT})
Temporary hearing damage can become permanent. Risk increases with severity and the configured maximum chance.
Maximum chance of temporary hearing damage to become permanent: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Maximum chance for temporary hearing damage to become permanent. More severe damage approaches this limit.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Misc_IntegrationBio: Replace blood bags with Biotech Hemogen packs (default: {DEFAULT})
Use Biotech hemogen packs in recipes that require blood bags.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Misc_IntegrationAno: Allow shamblers to acquire More Injuries conditions, including shock and fractures.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Misc_AnomalyRegener: Regeneration gradually clears fractures, spinal paralysis and permanent brain damage once injuries on that part heal. Personality shifts remain.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Misc_BleedingReduct: Multiplier for bleeding from closed internal injuries: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Internal-bleeding multiplier after the enclosing wound is bandaged. One leaves internal bleeding unchanged; zero stops it completely.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Misc_ParalysisEnabl: Severe spinal cord injuries can cause partial or complete paralysis.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Misc_ParalysisDamag: Spinal damage giving a 50% paralysis chance. The chance scales linearly with damage.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Misc_IntestinalSpil: Chance of intestinal spilling on damage: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Chance for severe abdominal injuries to spill digestive fluids, causing burns and infection risk.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_Features_Misc_BloodHarvestMi: Minimum required medical skill for blood harvesting: {VALUE} (default: {DEFAULT})
Minimum Medical skill to collect blood from a downed pawn for transfusion.
LanguageData.MI_Settings_VitalFailure_EnableTooltip: Delays supported vital-capacity deaths through organ failure and cerebral hypoxia. Complete unprotected oxygen deprivation can kill in about 1.5 game hours. Disabling restores ordinary capacity death. Required for the Death Rattle save transition.
LanguageData.MI_VitalFailure_DeathRattleConflict: More Injuries takes priority over Death Rattle. Follow the in-game migration notice before removing Death Rattle.
